messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service=redwood-inference-api v2.15, initial canary=10% regions=us-west,eu-west. Release notes: https://internal/release/2.15 :rocket:
lina: change-window set 02:00-02:30 UTC. tagging infra for visibility.
raj: seeing GPU OOMs on us-west nodes ~+2m into canary, few pod restarts. logs: https://logs/internal/gpu-ooms?since=10m
emily: confirmed 2 restarts in us-west-a; throughput degraded but not global.
infra_jp: recommendation: exclude us-west from canary to avoid global rollback. collect dmesg + driver logs.
neil: we can do a route-level exclusion. lina, can you run the exclude and lower concurrency?
lina: running commands now: ```deployctl rollout exclude-region --service redwood-inference-api --region us-west --reason "gpu OOMs" --now
deployctl config set --service redwood-inference-api --region us-west --max_inflight 30```
deploy-bot: Action executed: region excluded (us-west) at 1718000030. Automated canary increments paused.
emily: after exclusion us-west error rate dropped to baseline; infra will continue log collection.
raj: opening incident and tagging @hardware-team for follow-up.
infra_jp: if nodes are healthy after driver checks we can re-include with `deployctl rollout include-region --service redwood-inference-api --region us-west --version v2.15` (owner approval required).
lina: updating release notes with known-issue entry and holding the rollout. will post updates in #incidents. :white_check_mark:
